inbound.choose:
<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("accuknox-enabled", "") == "true")">
				
				
				
				
				
				<set-variable name="accuknox-request-body" value="@{
                    try
                    {
                        var ct = (context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("Content-Type", "") ?? "").ToLower();
                        if (ct != "" && !ct.Contains("json") && !ct.Contains("text")) { return string.Empty; }
                        return context.Request.Body?.As(preserveContent: true) ?? string.Empty;
                    }
                    catch { return string.Empty; }
                }" />
				
				<set-variable name="accuknox-model" value="@{
                    try
                    {
                        var m = string.Empty;
                        try { m = JObject.Parse(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("accuknox-request-body", ""))["model"]?.ToString() ?? string.Empty; } catch { }
                        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(m)) { m = context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("x-model", "") ?? string.Empty; }
                        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(m))
                        {
                            var path = context.Request.Url?.Path ?? string.Empty;
                            var match = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Match(path, @"/(?:deployments|models|model)/([^/:]+)", System.Text.RegularExpressions.RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
                            if (match.Success) { m = System.Uri.UnescapeDataString(match.Groups[1].Value); }
                        }
                        return (m ?? string.Empty).Trim().ToLower();
                    }
                    catch { return string.Empty; }
                }" />
				
				<set-variable name="accuknox-app-name" value="@{
                    var configured = (context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("accuknox-app-name", "") ?? "").Trim();
                    if (configured != "" && configured.ToLower() != "auto") { return configured; }

                    var m = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("accuknox-model", "") ?? "";
                    if (m.Contains("embed")) { return "embedding"; }
                    if (m.Contains("claude")) { return "claude"; }
                    if (m.Contains("gpt") || m.StartsWith("o1") || m.StartsWith("o3") || m.StartsWith("o4")) { return "gpt"; }
                    if (m.Contains("gemini") || m.Contains("gemma")) { return "gemini"; }
                    if (m.Contains("llama")) { return "llama"; }
                    if (m.Contains("mistral") || m.Contains("mixtral") || m.Contains("codestral")) { return "mistral"; }
                    if (m.Contains("command") || m.Contains("cohere")) { return "cohere"; }
                    if (m.Contains("titan") || m.Contains("nova")) { return "amazon"; }
                    if (m.Contains("deepseek")) { return "deepseek"; }
                    if (m.Contains("phi")) { return "phi"; }
                    if (m.Contains("grok")) { return "grok"; }
                    return string.Empty;
                }" />
				<set-variable name="accuknox-prompt" value="@{
                    var raw = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("accuknox-request-body", string.Empty) ?? string.Empty;
                    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(raw)) { return string.Empty; }

                    JObject body = null;
                    try { body = JObject.Parse(raw); } catch { return raw; }

                    try
                    {
                        // 1. Conversational payloads - latest user turn.
                        //    messages: OpenAI / Azure OpenAI / Anthropic / Mistral / Llama /
                        //              Cohere v2 / Bedrock Converse / Ollama chat
                        //    contents: Gemini / Vertex
                        //    input:    OpenAI Responses API (array form)
                        var turnFields = new string[] { "messages", "contents", "input" };
                        foreach (var field in turnFields)
                        {
                            JToken turns = body[field];
                            if (turns == null) { continue; }
                            if (turns.Type == JTokenType.Object) { turns = new JArray(turns); }
                            if (turns.Type != JTokenType.Array) { continue; }

                            var arr = (JArray)turns;
                            for (int i = arr.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
                            {
                                var turn = arr[i];
                                if (turn.Type != JTokenType.Object) { continue; }

                                // No role = single-turn payload, treated as user.
                                var role = ((turn["role"] ?? turn["author"])?.ToString() ?? string.Empty).ToLower();
                                if (role != "" && role != "user" && role != "human") { continue; }

                                JToken content = turn["content"] ?? turn["parts"] ?? turn["text"];
                                if (content == null) { continue; }
                                if (content.Type == JTokenType.String)
                                {
                                    var s = (string)content;
                                    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s)) { return s; }
                                    continue;
                                }
                                if (content.Type == JTokenType.Object) { content = new JArray(content); }
                                if (content.Type != JTokenType.Array) { continue; }

                                // Text blocks only: {type:text|input_text, text} or a
                                // type-less {text} (Gemini parts, Bedrock Converse).
                                // tool_result / image / audio blocks are skipped, so a
                                // tool-result-only user turn falls back to an earlier one.
                                var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
                                foreach (var block in (JArray)content)
                                {
                                    string t = null;
                                    if (block.Type == JTokenType.String) { t = (string)block; }
                                    else if (block.Type == JTokenType.Object)
                                    {
                                        var type = block["type"]?.ToString() ?? string.Empty;
                                        var tt = block["text"];
                                        if ((type == "" || type == "text" || type == "input_text") && tt != null && tt.Type == JTokenType.String) { t = (string)tt; }
                                    }
                                    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(t))
                                    {
                                        if (sb.Length > 0) { sb.Append("\n"); }
                                        sb.Append(t);
                                    }
                                }
                                if (sb.Length > 0) { return sb.ToString(); }
                            }
                        }

                        // 2. Single-shot payloads (string or array of strings).
                        //    input:     Responses API / embeddings
                        //    prompt:    legacy completions / Llama / Bedrock / Ollama
                        //    inputText: Amazon Titan
                        //    inputs:    Hugging Face TGI
                        //    message:   Cohere v1 chat
                        var promptFields = new string[] { "input", "prompt", "inputText", "inputs", "message", "query", "question", "text" };
                        foreach (var field in promptFields)
                        {
                            var tok = body[field];
                            if (tok == null) { continue; }
                            if (tok.Type == JTokenType.String)
                            {
                                var s = (string)tok;
                                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s)) { return s; }
                            }
                            else if (tok.Type == JTokenType.Array)
                            {
                                var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
                                foreach (var item in (JArray)tok)
                                {
                                    if (item.Type != JTokenType.String) { continue; }
                                    var s = (string)item;
                                    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s)) { continue; }
                                    if (sb.Length > 0) { sb.Append("\n"); }
                                    sb.Append(s);
                                }
                                if (sb.Length > 0) { return sb.ToString(); }
                            }
                        }

                        // 3. Vertex AI predict: instances[].prompt / instances[].content
                        if (body["instances"] != null && body["instances"].Type == JTokenType.Array)
                        {
                            var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
                            foreach (var inst in (JArray)body["instances"])
                            {
                                if (inst.Type != JTokenType.Object) { continue; }
                                var tok = inst["prompt"] ?? inst["content"];
                                if (tok == null || tok.Type != JTokenType.String) { continue; }
                                var s = (string)tok;
                                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s)) { continue; }
                                if (sb.Length > 0) { sb.Append("\n"); }
                                sb.Append(s);
                            }
                            if (sb.Length > 0) { return sb.ToString(); }
                        }

                        // Unknown shape -> raw body
                        return raw;
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                        return raw;
                    }
                }" />
				
					<when condition="@(
                        context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("accuknox-scan-prompt", false)
                        && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("accuknox-prompt", ""))
                    )">
						
							@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("accuknox-endpoint", ""))
							POST
							
								application/json
							
							
								Bearer {{accuknox-token}}
							
							<set-header name="client-Info" exists-action="@(string.IsNullOrEmpty(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("accuknox-app-name", "")) ? "delete" : "override")">
								@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("accuknox-app-name", ""))
							
							@{
                                return new JObject(
                                    new JProperty("query_type", "prompt"),
                                    new JProperty("content", context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("accuknox-prompt", string.Empty) ?? string.Empty)
                                ).ToString();
                            }
						
					
				
				
					accuknox-prompt-scan
					<metadata name="correlation_id" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("correlation-id", context.RequestId.ToString()) ?? "none")" />
					
					<metadata name="dispatched" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("accuknox-scan-prompt", false) && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("accuknox-prompt", "")) ? "true" : "false")" />
					<metadata name="prompt_chars" value="@((context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("accuknox-prompt", "") ?? "").Length.ToString())" />
					<metadata name="model" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("accuknox-model", "") ?? "")" />
					<metadata name="app_name" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("accuknox-app-name", "") ?? "")" />

outbound.choose:
<when condition="@(
                context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("accuknox-scan", false)
                && context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("accuknox-scan-response", false)
                && context.Response != null
                && context.Response.StatusCode >= 200
                && context.Response.StatusCode < 300
            )">
				<set-variable name="accuknox-response-text" value="@{
                    var raw = string.Empty;
                    try { raw = context.Response.Body?.As(preserveContent: true) ?? string.Empty; } catch { return string.Empty; }
                    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(raw)) { return string.Empty; }

                    try
                    {
                        // Split the body into JSON chunks
                        var chunks = new List();
                        var trimmed = raw.Trim();
                        var parsedWhole = false;
                        if (trimmed.StartsWith("{") || trimmed.StartsWith("["))
                        {
                            try
                            {
                                var whole = JToken.Parse(trimmed);
                                parsedWhole = true;
                                if (whole.Type == JTokenType.Object) { chunks.Add((JObject)whole); }
                                else if (whole.Type == JTokenType.Array)
                                {
                                    foreach (var item in (JArray)whole)
                                    {
                                        if (item.Type == JTokenType.Object) { chunks.Add((JObject)item); }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            catch { }
                        }
                        if (!parsedWhole)
                        {
                            // SSE (data: {...}) or NDJSON ({...} per line)
                            foreach (var line in raw.Split('\n'))
                            {
                                var l = line.Trim();
                                if (l.StartsWith("data:")) { l = l.Substring(5).Trim(); }
                                if (!l.StartsWith("{")) { continue; }
                                try { chunks.Add(JObject.Parse(l)); } catch { }
                            }
                        }
                        if (chunks.Count == 0) { return raw; }

                        var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
                        foreach (var c in chunks)
                        {
                            // Tokens that are a string, a text block or an array of text blocks
                            var candidates = new List();
                            var evt = c["type"]?.ToString() ?? string.Empty;

                            if (evt.StartsWith("response."))
                            {
                                // Responses API stream: only deltas carry new text;
                                // response.completed repeats the whole output.
                                if (evt == "response.output_text.delta" || evt == "response.refusal.delta") { candidates.Add(c["delta"]); }
                            }
                            else if (evt == "content_block_delta")
                            {
                                // Anthropic stream
                                candidates.Add(c["delta"]?["text"]);
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                // Anthropic Messages
                                candidates.Add(c["content"]);

                                // OpenAI / Azure OpenAI chat + legacy completions (+ stream chunks)
                                if (c["choices"] != null && c["choices"].Type == JTokenType.Array)
                                {
                                    foreach (var choice in (JArray)c["choices"])
                                    {
                                        if (choice.Type != JTokenType.Object) { continue; }
                                        candidates.Add(choice["message"]?["content"]);
                                        candidates.Add(choice["message"]?["refusal"]);
                                        candidates.Add(choice["delta"]?["content"]);
                                        candidates.Add(choice["delta"]?["refusal"]);
                                        candidates.Add(choice["text"]);
                                    }
                                }

                                // Responses API (output array) / Bedrock Converse (output object)
                                if (c["output"] != null && c["output"].Type == JTokenType.Array)
                                {
                                    foreach (var item in (JArray)c["output"])
                                    {
                                        if (item.Type == JTokenType.Object) { candidates.Add(item["content"]); }
                                    }
                                }
                                else if (c["output"] != null && c["output"].Type == JTokenType.Object)
                                {
                                    candidates.Add(c["output"]["message"]?["content"]);
                                }

                                // Gemini / Vertex
                                if (c["candidates"] != null && c["candidates"].Type == JTokenType.Array)
                                {
                                    foreach (var cand in (JArray)c["candidates"])
                                    {
                                        if (cand.Type == JTokenType.Object) { candidates.Add(cand["content"]?["parts"]); }
                                    }
                                }
                                if (c["predictions"] != null && c["predictions"].Type == JTokenType.Array)
                                {
                                    foreach (var pred in (JArray)c["predictions"])
                                    {
                                        if (pred.Type == JTokenType.String) { candidates.Add(pred); }
                                        else if (pred.Type == JTokenType.Object) { candidates.Add(pred["content"]); }
                                    }
                                }

                                // Cohere v2 / Ollama chat
                                if (c["message"] != null && c["message"].Type == JTokenType.Object) { candidates.Add(c["message"]["content"]); }

                                // Bedrock Mistral outputs[].text, Titan results[].outputText
                                if (c["outputs"] != null && c["outputs"].Type == JTokenType.Array)
                                {
                                    foreach (var o in (JArray)c["outputs"])
                                    {
                                        if (o.Type == JTokenType.Object) { candidates.Add(o["text"]); }
                                    }
                                }
                                if (c["results"] != null && c["results"].Type == JTokenType.Array)
                                {
                                    foreach (var r in (JArray)c["results"])
                                    {
                                        if (r.Type == JTokenType.Object) { candidates.Add(r["outputText"]); }
                                    }
                                }

                                // Scalar string fields: Responses output_text, Cohere v1 text,
                                // Bedrock Llama generation / Claude-legacy completion,
                                // Ollama response, Hugging Face generated_text
                                var scalarFields = new string[] { "output_text", "text", "generation", "completion", "response", "generated_text", "outputText" };
                                foreach (var f in scalarFields)
                                {
                                    if (c[f] != null && c[f].Type == JTokenType.String) { candidates.Add(c[f]); }
                                }
                            }

                            foreach (var cand in candidates)
                            {
                                if (cand == null) { continue; }
                                var blocks = cand.Type == JTokenType.Array ? (JArray)cand : new JArray(cand);
                                foreach (var block in blocks)
                                {
                                    string t = null;
                                    if (block.Type == JTokenType.String) { t = (string)block; }
                                    else if (block.Type == JTokenType.Object)
                                    {
                                        var type = block["type"]?.ToString() ?? string.Empty;
                                        if (type == "refusal" && block["refusal"] != null && block["refusal"].Type == JTokenType.String) { t = (string)block["refusal"]; }
                                        else if ((type == "" || type == "text" || type == "output_text") && block["text"] != null && block["text"].Type == JTokenType.String) { t = (string)block["text"]; }
                                    }
                                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(t)) { sb.Append(t); }
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        if (sb.Length > 0) { return sb.ToString(); }

                        // Embedding vectors carry no text - skip instead of sending raw
                        if (raw.Contains("\"embedding\"")) { return string.Empty; }
                        return raw;
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                        return raw;
                    }
                }" />
				
					<when condition="@(!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("accuknox-response-text", "")))">
						
							@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("accuknox-endpoint", ""))
							POST
							
								application/json
							
							
								Bearer {{accuknox-token}}
							
							<set-header name="client-Info" exists-action="@(string.IsNullOrEmpty(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("accuknox-app-name", "")) ? "delete" : "override")">
								@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("accuknox-app-name", ""))
							
							
							@{
                                return new JObject(
                                    new JProperty("query_type", "response"),
                                    new JProperty("content", context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("accuknox-response-text", string.Empty) ?? string.Empty),
                                    new JProperty("session_id", string.Empty)
                                ).ToString();
                            }
						
					
				
				
					accuknox-response-scan
					<metadata name="correlation_id" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("correlation-id", context.RequestId.ToString()) ?? "none")" />
					
					<metadata name="dispatched" value="@(!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("accuknox-response-text", "")) ? "true" : "false")" />
					<metadata name="response_chars" value="@((context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("accuknox-response-text", "") ?? "").Length.ToString())" />
					<metadata name="model" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("accuknox-model", "") ?? "")" />
					<metadata name="app_name" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("accuknox-app-name", "") ?? "")" />
